declarations.docstring: There are auxiliary presentations whose zeroth and first components are products of cyclic groups determined by pairwise gcds, while every component indexed two or more is subsingleton.
Every component indexed by a natural number plus two is subsingleton when the first input is finite over the integers.
For presentations with nonzero indexed coefficients, the component at one is additively equivalent to the product of cyclic groups whose orders are the corresponding gcds.
The zeroth component associated to two cyclic groups of orders `a` and `c` is isomorphic to the cyclic group of order `a.gcd c`.
The component at zero is additively equivalent to the product of cyclic groups whose orders are gcds of the indexed coefficients.
An indexed module is linearly equivalent over the integers to the cyclic group whose order is the absolute value of its associated coefficient.
An indexed object is isomorphic to the integer module carried by the cyclic group whose order is the absolute value of its associated coefficient.
The quotient of `ZMod c` by the span of the image of `a` is additively equivalent to `ZMod (a.gcd c)`.
